subject: BUG-266: _KNOWN_HOUSES is incomplete, so syncProgress silently drops ALA/eth/career completions
description:
FOUND 2026-09-07 while validating a proposed fix against a production snapshot BEFORE shipping it -- the check the deriveXP near-miss taught us to run. functions/index.js:1451 _KNOWN_HOUSES = [web, shield, forge, script, cloud, code, key, eye, ai, linux, arena]. It is MISSING at least 'ala', 'eth' and 'career'. _isValidModuleId (:1452) rejects any id whose house is not in that list, and syncProgress FILTERS client-supplied ids through it at :1494 (localModules) and :1497 (localLabs). MEASURED against all 7528 real completion ids held by 3874 production users: 16 would be rejected (0.2%). Examples: ala-w1-cli, ala-w1-network-diag, eth-final, eth-l03, eth-l04, eth-l06, career-explorer, and forge-forge-core2-virtualization-lab. LIVE CONSEQUENCE: a student finishing ALA, ethics or career content today has that completion silently filtered out of syncProgress. It survives ONLY because recordProgress has no validation at all and writes it unfiltered -- so the ABSENCE of validation on one callable is currently compensating for a WRONG validation on the other. THE TRAP THIS AVOIDED: the BUG-264 fix plan called for adding _isValidModuleId to recordProgress for parity. Doing that would have stopped ALA/eth/career progress from recording anywhere, breaking three courses to close a forgery hole. Caught only because a snapshot existed to test the rule against real data. SEPARATE DEFECT IN THE SAME RULE: 'forge-forge-core2-virtualization-lab' is rejected by the key.startsWith(house + '-') clause, which was presumably meant to catch a doubled house prefix but also rejects a legitimate id whose key genuinely begins with the house name. FIX ORDER: correct _KNOWN_HOUSES and the doubled-prefix clause FIRST, verify against the snapshot that 0 of 7528 real ids are rejected, and only THEN add the shape check to recordProgress. Do not add validation to recordProgress before this is fixed.
[2026-09-07 01:59] UPGRADE TO ACTIVE DATA LOSS -- worse than filed. functions/index.js:1548-1549 apply _isValidModuleId to the CLOUD side of the merge, not just the caller's payload: mergedModules = [...new Set([...(cloudData.modulesCompleted || []).filter(_isValidModuleId), ...localModules])], and the same for labs. So syncProgress does not merely ignore an ALA/eth/career completion arriving from a client -- IT DELETES ONE ALREADY STORED IN THE STUDENT'S RECORD, every time the student syncs. The 16 affected ids (ala-w1-cli, ala-w1-network-diag, eth-final, eth-l03, eth-l04, eth-l06, career-explorer, forge-forge-core2-virtualization-lab and others) are being stripped from real accounts on an ordinary page load. WHY THEY STILL EXIST IN TODAY'S SNAPSHOT: recordProgress has no validation and re-adds them, so the two callables are fighting -- recordProgress writes the completion back, syncProgress strips it out again. Whichever ran last decides what the student sees, which also explains progress that appears to come and go. THE SNAPSHOT IS THE EVIDENCE BASE: progress-2026-09-07T01-56-25-288Z.json holds all 7528 completion ids across 3874 users as of tonight, so after the house list is corrected the same 16 can be confirmed present rather than reconstructed from memory. DO NOT 'fix parity' by adding _isValidModuleId to recordProgress -- that would remove the only thing currently restoring these completions and complete the deletion. Correct _KNOWN_HOUSES (add ala, eth, career at minimum) and the key.startsWith(house + '-') clause that rejects forge-forge-core2-virtualization-lab, verify 0 of 7528 real ids are rejected, and only then consider parity.
